digest.component_or_area: Plan clarity and deterministic review gates
propositions: Empty parsed Acceptance Criteria checkbox items must fail standalone clarity and deterministic P1 readiness checks
Unresolved sentinel tokens (TBD, TODO, FIXME, ???) in active execution sections must fail standalone clarity and P1 readiness when they appear as value assignments
Sentinel matches must be suppressed when the same line contains negation or removal terms (no, zero, remove, delete, reject, forbid, must not, without)
Fenced code blocks and inline backtick code must not trigger sentinel detection rules
Plan-review P1 gate and standalone clarity gate must enforce the same defect floor without changing ticket-type exemptions or legacy compatibility scores
Historical negative controls and cross-surface regression tests must verify agreement between the two gate surfaces
